chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever drinks an intoxicant, his prayer will not be accepted from him for forty nights.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the validity of prayer for someone who consumes intoxicants?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* from the chain of Samaanah, this hadith specifies that the prayer of one who consumes an intoxicant is not accepted for forty nights, a period often interpreted as a spiritual purification phase. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that major sins can temporarily suspend the validity of ritual worship, linking physical consumption directly to spiritual state.
